name: Natsu no Koi.
source:
Main character is a student. He may choose to go to the sea, socialize or rest after part-time job and depending on that reach one of the prepared endings.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名學生。打完工後，他可以選擇去海邊、與人交往或休息，並根據選擇抵達不同結局。

［譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]］
